beats.headline: Bought for the housekeeping
beats.text: A personal space upgrade bought from the Bopca for twenty-five thousand gold, one of the cheapest there is. Katia pays without a word, because the room is swimming in ghoul blood, and the bot sets to work at once. It is going to take a long time.

beats.headline: A white one, pocketed
beats.text: In the surgical theatre of the Madness castle, the fourth table is empty and drenched in blood, and a cleaner bot of the same model as the crew's own, painted solid white, is slurping it off the floor. Carl lands on that table, slips in the blood and goes flat on his back. The bot shrieks, beeps and comes at him. He apologises, grabs it in both hands, feels the buzz that means it will go in his inventory, and puts it there, somewhat to his own surprise.

beats.headline: A second bot, reset
beats.text: The cleaner bot has a disintegration ray. It uses it on the broken kitchen table, beeping with satisfaction at each puff of smoke, and then it faces a mountain of a dead naga's junk and very nearly has a heart attack. Carl hands Mordecai the second cleaner bot, a slightly smaller white one, an old model with blood on it from Architect Houston's operating theater, and asks him to get it working for them before anything valuable gets zapped. Mordecai switches it off to reset it. The two bots beep at each other.

beats.headline: Sold out due to overwhelming demand
beats.text: Since the previous floor, crawlers have been complaining that the Cleaner Bot upgrade is missing from the personal space shop, due to "overwhelming demand." Everyone blamed warlords stockpiling for Faction Wars, which was partly true. The white one Carl looted from Architect Houston's surgical theatre was an old model and, as it happens, the last one the store had. The rest of the demand has a single name: Herot, with a standing order to buy every cleaner bot that shows up. Which makes a household appliance the most interesting item in the shop.

beats.headline: Suckira, and Ezra Fitz the Second
beats.text: There are two cleaner bots now, so Donut insists on names. The white one is Suckira, after the robot vacuum Louis's mother had in Florida; Louis won the right in a coin flip that Samantha conducted and says she rigged. The other is Ezra Fitz the Second, because, Donut explains, Ezra Fitz sucks. The method is a sale: crawler into an XL pet carrier, carrier into the bot's weight-based storage, bot into the shop, where Herot buys it. One bot holds perhaps fifty people, and a sold bot cannot be relisted for thirty days.

beats.headline: Forty seats, and a hundred and five
beats.text: The Pineapple Cabaret transfer goes smoothly. Carl's cleaner bot fits forty people. The one belonging to Bobby Montague, the Illusionist with the tall hair, somehow fits a hundred and five. Two hundred and twenty-seven crawlers go across, not counting Li Na, among them Zhang, Tran, Bautista and Archie. All the cleaner bots were bought up immediately, which is a strange career for a housekeeping upgrade.
